events.title: BWA Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Cost Controls, Charging Exit
events.body: BorgWarner beats on Q1 EPS and revenues as margins improve on cost controls, offsetting a 4.2% organic sales drop and mixed segment demand.

events.title: BorgWarner (BWA) Beats Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
events.body: BorgWarner (BWA) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +6.83% and +1.74%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: EVgo Inc. (EVGO) Reports Q1 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
events.body: EVgo (EVGO) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +11.11% and +25.19%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: BorgWarner Gears Up to Report Q1 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
events.body: BWA heads into Q1 earnings with mixed signals as China momentum and EV deals offset the weak battery segment and softer 2026 sales outlook.
